## Accessing Real-Time Transit Information

<span class="catalog-badge" style="--catalog-badge-bg:var(--vp-c-default-soft)"><code style="background:none;padding:0;margin:0;border:0;">step:001</code></span>

- Domain: Pre-Trip Information
- Physical spaces: Home, Workplace, Café
- Description: Passengers access real-time transit information through various channels such as mobile apps, websites, or digital displays at stops.
- Touchpoints: Mobile App, Website, Digital Stop Displays
- User actions: Open the transit app or website., Check real-time arrival times for nearby stops., Plan the trip based on current transit conditions.
- Goals: Obtain accurate and timely information about transit options., Make informed decisions about departure times and routes.
- Pain points: Lack of access to real-time data., Difficulty navigating apps or websites.
- Metrics: App/website load time., User satisfaction ratings., Frequency of real-time data updates.
- Followed by: step:002
